independent_audit.correctness_scope: This offline audit verifies recorded full-output checks, original reference and tolerance hashes, and numerical-error diagnostics. Raw output arrays are not included in the result JSON, so the error values cannot be independently recomputed offline.
independent_audit.final_source_scope: Measurements use frozen baseline d5f7a90. Final integrated source must be tied to these binaries by the separate complete PTX equivalence audit; this report verifies the measured frozen snapshot and does not claim final-source byte identity.
independent_audit.statistical_scope: Six balanced warm calls per variant; median of all six call medians. No post-hoc resampling, confidence interval, cold-score extrapolation, or significance claim is made.
